study_identification_part.si_4_title: Lifespan Normative Models of White Matter Fractional Anisotropy: Applications to Early Psychosis

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Warped Bayesian linear regression with a non-linear basis expansion over age for lifespan normative models.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: We then fit lifespan normative models to these data on the basis of age, sex, site and race using warped Bayesian linear regression (BLR) and a non-linear basis expansion over age

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Fractional anisotropy (FA) values, summarized as mean FA across 48 white matter tracts.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: DTI modelling to extract fractional anisotropy (FA) values, Tract-Based Spatial Statistics (TBSS) for skeletonised FA images, and segmentation with the Johns Hopkins University (JHU) atlas to compute mean FA values across 48 white matter tracts.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Predictors include age, sex, site, and race.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: We then fit lifespan normative models to these data on the basis of age, sex, site and race
